import json
from tools.fundamentals import (
    get_financial_statements,
    get_financial_ratios,
    get_growth_metrics,
    get_historical_valuation,
)

SYM = "AMD"
OUT = "work/amd_fundamental_analysis/data"

def dump(name, obj):
    with open(f"{OUT}/{name}.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f, indent=2)
    print(f"saved {name}.json")

# Quarterly income statement — revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income
inc = get_financial_statements(symbol=SYM, statement_type="income", period="quarter", limit=12)
dump("income_quarter", inc)

# Quarterly balance sheet (for debt/cash)
bal = get_financial_statements(symbol=SYM, statement_type="balance", period="quarter", limit=8)
dump("balance_quarter", bal)

# Quarterly cash flow
cf = get_financial_statements(symbol=SYM, statement_type="cash", period="quarter", limit=8)
dump("cash_quarter", cf)

# Quarterly ratios
ratios = get_financial_ratios(symbol=SYM, period="quarter", limit=12)
dump("ratios_quarter", ratios)

# Quarterly growth metrics
growth = get_growth_metrics(symbol=SYM, period="quarter", limit=12)
dump("growth_quarter", growth)

# Valuation history (annual)
val = get_historical_valuation(symbol=SYM, period="annual", limit=10)
dump("valuation_annual", val)

# Print a quick summary of the income statement records
data = inc.get("data", [])
print(f"\nIncome statement records: {len(data)}")
for r in data[:8]:
    print({k: r.get(k) for k in ("date", "revenue", "grossProfit", "operatingIncome", "netIncome", "eps")})
